infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wasl uses your camera for 18+ age verification, Live video chat, and club voice spaces.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wasl uses the microphone for Live video chat and club voice spaces.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Wasl needs your location (city/region) to show nearby matches and keep the community safe. Location is required to use the app.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Optional: import contacts in Settings if you want to block people you know from finding you on Wasl.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Wasl uses your photo library for profile photos, stories, and chat images.
